profile.name: AegeanWorks
profile.description: AegeanWorks - an independent studio building local-first AI systems, cognitive tooling, and computational research.

repositories.name: Aegean-Licensing
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Aegean Licensing is integrated into AegeanWorks/AIKit. The Aegean License family (AL, AGL and ASL 1.1), the commercial program and certificate verification now ship as aegean_licensing/ plus licenses/ and COMMERCIAL.md.

repositories.name: Aegean-Reforge
repositories.description: Archived: Aegean Reforge is integrated into AegeanWorks/AIKit. Progressive, evidence-backed Git history auditing and safe repair now ships as reforge/ plus reforge.py.

repositories.name: AIKit
repositories.description: Crash-resilient governance and delivery gates for AI coding agents: versioned task ledger, commit-level verification, secret scanning and per-project gates. Free for personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Aldervale
repositories.description: A 2.5D medieval RPG drawn in tiny ASCII cells: low-poly 3D models baked into shaded sprites, voxel terrain, fog, day and night, water, quests, combat, loot, shops and saves. Python standard library only: no dependencies, no assets, no build step. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Assay
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Tamper-evident audit evidence for AI agents.

repositories.name: Chronos
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Chronos is a lightweight, local-first developer focus and session orchestrator. It helps developers track deep-work sessions, manage micro-milestones, log interruptions, and generate productivity insights with zero external dependencies.

repositories.name: Crypt-Crawler
repositories.description: Tactical turn-based web dungeon crawler with procedural levels, Normal/Hard difficulty, class passives, status combos, per-floor omens, a turn-cost trap search and disarm, mimic chests, a two-way merchant, seed replay, five-slot equipment, side-by-side loot comparison, filterable inventory, a persistent lore codex, branching soul encounters...

repositories.name: Cyberpulse
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] CyberPulse is a retro-cyberpunk terminal hacking simulation game designed around empirical behavioral psychology: procedural puzzle nodes, seeded side-subnet hosts, ICE defenses, push-your-luck extraction, persistent career progression and a five-act story campaign, played in the terminal or the Web Cyberdeck.

repositories.name: Fluid-Universe
repositories.description: Falsification-first research codebase testing a Z3 circulant origin of the Koide lepton relation, with a separately labelled nematic-fluid UV speculation. Free non-commercial research under ASL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Fold
repositories.description: A 4x4 tile-merge puzzle you run on your own machine: one Python process, a browser page, no dependencies, no account and no network calls. Slide, merge and chase 2048; the server owns the rules and the browser only renders. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Gauge
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A zero-dependency terminal ruler for numeric series. gauge reads numbers from arguments, a file or a pipe and draws a sparkline, signed bars, a histogram, a box plot or a compact statistics block. stats --json is the machine surface for another tool.

repositories.name: Lacon
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] An AI that thinks in as few letters as possible, recursively over a long context. Everything is in this project: the alphabet, the budget, the thinker and the recursive engine. No network, no API key, no model weights. The core is standard library only; an optional adapter reads Pebble source when the sibling Pebble project is...

repositories.name: Lattice
repositories.description: A provenance-first research knowledge graph for humans and AI agents. Local-first, SQLite-backed and standard library only. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: MemoryReconstruction
repositories.description: A top-down action roguelike about rebuilding a shattered world from lost memories.

repositories.name: Meridian
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A zero-dependency time zone meeting planner that runs entirely in the browser: add people and cities, compare every local hour side by side, find the overlap that works for everyone, then share it as a link or a calendar file.

repositories.name: Mnemo
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A dependency-free, local-first spaced-repetition flashcard CLI. Add what you want to remember, study it on the days the SM-2 algorithm says it is due, and watch the schedule stretch as you recall and compress it when you forget. Everything stays in one readable JSON file on your machine.

repositories.name: Muse
repositories.description: Prompt-driven AI music creation with an automated listener that scores how well each track fits the theme and can retry using the judge's own suggestions, exposed as a CLI (single tracks or a JSON batch) and Python library.

repositories.name: N1-Engine
repositories.description: A local-first, privacy-focused platform for rigorous N-of-1 self-experimentation: apply scientific statistics to your own life data, on your own machine. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeuralBeat
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] The Ultimate Neuro-Acoustic Desktop Application

repositories.name: NeuralDeck
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Your personal, privacy-focused AI assistant for creating Anki flashcards from any document.

repositories.name: NeuroCore
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A complete, self-hosted AI agent framework. Visual flow editor · Persistent memory · RAG · Tools · Multi-platform messaging · Community marketplace.

repositories.name: NeurologyClinicTemplates-TR
repositories.description: Standardized Turkish anamnesis (patient history) templates for common neurology complaints, helping neurologists, residents and medical students document assessments completely and systematically. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeuroOptic
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] NeuroOptic is a research-grade visual oscillator for brainwave entrainment: configurable 1-120 Hz frequencies, hardware-aware safety limits and drift-free phase accumulation.

repositories.name: NobetWizard
repositories.description: An automated duty roster generator built with Streamlit: fair monthly schedules under constraints such as gender, rest days and availability, with Excel and PDF export, in English and Turkish. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NoMoreClutter
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] An intelligent AI-powered desktop application that automatically organizes your files using Large Language Models (LLMs). Say goodbye to cluttered folders and let AI analyze, categorize, and rename your files with smart descriptive names!

repositories.name: Orrery
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] An N-body gravitational sandbox that runs in your terminal or in your browser. Nine carefully chosen worlds, a symplectic integrator, optional relativity and collision physics, live energy diagnostics, orbit trails, CSV and JSON export, and no dependencies outside the Python standard library.

repositories.name: Pebble
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A tiny, dependency-free scripting language: lexer, parser, tree-walking evaluator and REPL. Built as an AIKit evaluation project — the process is under test as much as the code.

repositories.name: Photo-Harbor
repositories.description: Self-hosted photo server for Windows: an iPhone sends new photos over home Wi-Fi through Apple Shortcuts, no app needed, and an optional native Android app does the same, with a verified-hash cleanup and a gallery.

repositories.name: PNN
repositories.description: Oral, blood-brain barrier-penetrant agents that soften hypothalamic perineuronal nets to restore insulin signaling in obesity: research notes, data and computational analyses. Free non-commercial research under ASL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Primordia
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Primordia is a zero-dependency evolution sandbox: seed a biosphere, run its clock, and watch genomes vary, compete and speciate. A run replays exactly from its seed, and a fossil record keeps the story of what happened.

repositories.name: Prism-Relay
repositories.description: A neon light-routing puzzle game: rotate mirrors and splitters, fold beams through portals, and charge every receiver across three episodes. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Research-Engine
repositories.description: A falsification-first research engine that turns questions into provenance-backed claims, executable kill tests, and auditable verdicts.

repositories.name: Tally
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A dependency-free, local-first expense ledger for the terminal. Record what you spend, list it, and see where the money went. Everything stays in one readable JSON file on your machine.

repositories.name: Tempo
repositories.description: A focus timer you run on your own machine: one Python process, a browser page, no dependencies, no account and no network calls. Focus and break phases alternate, and every fourth break is a long one. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: UI-Sandbox
repositories.description: A small React + Vite surface for exercising AIKit's bounded UI guard: one screen, token-driven theming, and a labelled control for every interaction. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Voidfarer
repositories.description: A zero-dependency space flight and exploration simulator with an autonomous deep-space fleet, a procedural galaxy and a Windows cockpit: route reactor power, board derelicts, scoop fuel, command drones, fight and trade. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Palette
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A zero-dependency, Photoshop-style image editor for the browser. Layers, filters, undo/redo and local export; images never leave the device.

repositories.name: Afterimage
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A visual perception gauntlet with a daily challenge: one tile in every grid is a shade, a size, or an angle off. Installable, offline-capable PWA.

repositories.name: Cairn
repositories.description: An agent-first systems language with its own x86-64 backend. Cairn compiles straight to a Windows PE executable: no C compiler, no assembler, no linker, no libc, no runtime library.

repositories.name: Driftwood
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Offline CLI that ranks code hotspots by combining git churn history with file complexity, so maintainers know where refactoring pays off.

repositories.name: Dupefinder
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Read-only duplicate file finder that groups byte-identical files by size and SHA-256 and reports reclaimable space.

repositories.name: Dustline
repositories.description: Dustline: Survivors is a top-down horde-survival shooter with endless procedural arenas, auto-firing weapons, 7 maps, 18 mob types, rotating bosses plus megas, Boss Rush mode and extraction banking.

repositories.name: Iris
repositories.description: A neon color-mixing puzzle: route red, green and blue beams through rotating mirrors and dye cells, blend exact hues, and light every receiver across three episodes.

repositories.name: ModelDuck
repositories.description: A local GGUF model server and coding-model tuner: load a model, serve an OpenAI-compatible API, tune it for code. Runs on the CPU or a Vulkan GPU; no cloud account, no telemetry.

repositories.name: Pocket-Planner
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A local-first task manager for capturing, prioritizing, and completing work from a fast terminal workflow.

repositories.name: Tessera
repositories.description: A seamless pattern studio: compose geometric tiles in the browser and export crisp SVG.

repositories.name: Weft
repositories.description: A zero-dependency thread-routing puzzle: draw glowing threads between matching spools, fill every cell of the loom, and restore the tapestry across twenty-four chambers, with a fresh 7x7 daily weave. Static HTML/CSS/ES modules for any static host.

repositories.name: ChatDuck
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A fast, local-first web chat UI for any OpenAI-compatible model server, including ModelDuck. It is one static page and a few modules: no build step, no framework, no backend, and no telemetry.

repositories.name: Atlas
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] An interactive visual knowledge platform for learning material — easy drag-and-drop.

repositories.name: Keystone
repositories.description: A small, game-agnostic 3D engine core in Python: OpenGL 3.3 PBR rendering, scene graph, meshes/OBJ, fixed-step loop, rebindable input, animation, particles, audio, collision, replay, atomic saves, batch planning/merging, and a HUD/profiler overlay with an embedded bitmap font.

repositories.name: Aegean-TGE
repositories.description: Native Windows hybrid CPU and GPU LLM inference engine in C++20 that treats system RAM and GPU VRAM as one coordinated memory tier.

repositories.name: AegeanWorks
repositories.description: AegeanWorks is an independent studio building local-first AI systems, cognitive tooling, and computational research. The work favors small composable parts, inspectable state, and software that still works when the network does not.

repositories.name: Brain
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A deterministic agent with memory, a planner and a self-model: talk to it in a terminal, or run the ablation and telemetry batteries.

repositories.name: Postbox
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] A local webhook inbox with replay. Point a webhook at it, inspect what arrived, then replay it to another target. Zero dependencies, Python 3.10+, localhost only.

repositories.name: Probe
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Local-first capability probe: a falsifiable CLI that runs an inspectable battery of environment checks - filesystem round-trip, shell execution, git state, imports and timing - and writes a verifiable JSON report of what was actually measured.

repositories.name: Trireme
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] [!WARNING] Archived AIKit development testbed — do not use in production. This project exists only to exercise and validate AIKit's tooling and workflows. It is read-only and unmaintained: there will be no further development, fixes, updates, or support.

repositories.name: Coda
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Coda is a deterministic, dependency-free Rust sound compiler that turns a small textual score into reproducible stereo WAV audio, with seeded arrangement styles for locally generated music. It is published as a public repository at github.com/AegeanWorks/Coda.

repositories.name: Sieve
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Sieve is a zero-dependency, deterministic regular-expression engine and ripgrep-like CLI written in Rust, with inspectable matching, a small pattern language and no network calls.

repositories.name: Shooter
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Fast arena shooter on the Keystone engine. Engine owns render/loop/input/serialization (projects/keystone); this package owns state/rules/scene and loads via --game shooter.game:ShooterGame.

repositories.name: Neon-Dash
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Neon Dash is a deterministic 3D obstacle-dodger on the Keystone engine: start from a title screen with your run records, pick a difficulty, dodge tall walls and lane-tracking hunter drones, jump low barriers, chain orb combos and near misses, grab shield/slow/magnet power-ups, clear three checkpoints, and defeat the Warden boss...

repositories.name: Vaultbreak
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Multi-floor 3D relic heist game and live subsystem testbed for the Keystone Engine (projects/keystone): 5 Vault Floors, directional stealth vision cones and acoustic hearing, sweeping security cameras, hackable Security Terminal + TileMap.with_cell secret breach, bouncing EMP/Smoke orbs (resolve_sphere_aabb + ray_sphere), crouch...

repositories.name: Atelier
repositories.description: [ARCHIVED] Local-first agent workspace: multi-conversation chat, file editing, git diffs, terminal, browser preview, and plans in one fast UI for any model API.

repositories.name: Sextant
repositories.description: Sextant is a deterministic, zero-dependency Rust CLI that verifies finite state machines, replays event scripts into auditable traces, and guards stateful behavior with golden-trace regression.
